book.name: 2 Tesalonika
book.title: Rau Ite Inim Ru To Paulus Imbooda Ila To Yes Tesalonika 2 Tesalonaika—2 Thessalonians

content: Paulus ighason yes Tesalonika ighaze tighuri ila suŋuuŋ todi

Yo, yam toŋvetaz, nisavia saveeŋ tonene, ve isob. Yei nighaze yam aghur ghei ila suŋuuŋ tiam, ve aghason Maaron pa iuul ghei pa uraat tiei. Leso saveeŋ to Tiina toit ilaan rikia irau ndug, ve tamtoghon tighita inimale mbeb tiina padi, ve titaghoni tinimale yam.
Ve aghasoni paam pa ipaghau ghei pa ndiran samsamiadi to ŋgar todi poia maau. Pasa, yam awatag: Tamtoghon tisob tighur ila sone. Mk 13:10; Ro 15:30+
Eemoghon iit irau tanumeer Tiina toit. Pasa, ye itaghon saveeŋ toni irau sawa isob. Ye tau pale ipalot gham, ve ipoon gham pa Ŋgeu Samia. Yo 17:15; 1Kor 10:13; 1Tes 5:24; 2Pe 2:9
Tiina toit igham ghei nighur ila kat tovene: Ŋgar isob to yei nisavia payam nighaze ataghoni, nene yam pale ataghoni. To aazne, ve itaghoni taghoni gha ila.
Ve nighaze Tiina toit ipaghazoŋan ŋgar tiam, leso aghilaal kat ila lolomim aghaze: Maaron lolo payam. Ve nighaze Krisi ipalot gham, leso ayoon ariaŋa pa badooŋ pataŋani animale ye tau.
Taneep sorok malep. Tagham uraat

Yam toŋvetaz, yei nisaav ariaŋa payam ila Tiina toit Yesu Krisi iza tovene: Ighaze toŋvetaz eta to Krisi igham uraat maau, ve inepneep sorok, yam agharaui malep. Aneep saguan pani. Pasa ŋgar tovene, nene deŋia pa Maaron aliŋa to nisavia payam ne maau. Saveeŋ tonene, paghu maau. Ineep muuŋ ve inim.
Yam awatag: Sawa to ninepneep toman gham, yei nineep sorok maau. Nigham uraat. Ŋgar tiei tonene, yam irau ataghoni.

Ve nighan aniiŋ to tamtoghon eta sorok maau. Nigholghol aniiŋ ve nighanghan. Pasa, lolomai pa nigham pataŋani pa tiam eta maau. Tauto mboŋ ve ndag, nirab taumai pa uraat, leso nindeeŋ lemai yaam ris pa iuul ghei. Mbaŋ 18:3; 2Kor 11:9; 1Tes 2:9
Onoon, sawa tonenen, yei irau nighur matamai payam pa ulaaŋ pida. Eemoghon nighason gham maau. Pasa, nighaze nipatooŋ gham pa ŋgar poia, leso aghita ve ataghoni. Lu 10:7; 1Kor 9:4
Ve sawa to nineep toman gham, yei nighur tutuuŋ ariaŋa payam tovene: Ighaze tamtoghon eta lolo pa ghamuuŋ uraat maau, ye irau ighan maau. Mbnp 3:19; 1Tes 4:11
Eemoghon nilooŋ tighaze tamtoghon tiam pida tigham uraat maau. Tinepneep sorok, ve tiwalaghlaagh taghon ruum ruum, ve tisia ledi savsaveeŋ to nditadi. 1Tim 5:13
Ndiran tovene, yei nisaav ariaŋa padi ila Tiina toit Yesu Krisi iza nighaze tiput taudi, ve nimadi iyaryaaŋ pa uraat todi. Leso tiŋgin taudi pa ledi mbeb. Ep 4:28
Ve yam toŋvetaz, tinimim imum pa ghamuuŋ ŋgar poia malep. Ga 6:9
Saveeŋ to nimbooda ila rau tonene, ighaze tiam eta itaghoni maau, yam aghita ve aneep saguan pani. Agharaui malep. Leso ighilaal sosor toni ve maya. Mt 18:17
Eemoghon aghita inimale koiamim malep. Aghita inimale toŋvetaz to Krisi, ve apasaluŋgani. Ga 6:1; 1Tes 5:14
Paesiiŋ pida to Paulus
Tiina toit Yesu, ye ŋgar luuma pughu. Sawa isob, ye tau pale igham gham aneep poia pa mbeb to naol ne, ve aneep toman lolomim luuma. Ve ye pale ineep toman gham asob. Ro 15:33; 1Tes 5:23
You Paulus, taug nimag ve nambood ndag poia tiou ilat payam. You napasob rau tiou to naol ne tovene, leso tamtoghon tighilaal tighaze taug to nambood di. Nene bodeeŋ tiou tovene.
Poia to Tiina toit Yesu Krisi ineep toman gham asob. Onoon. 1Kor 16:23
